name: Enterprise Knowledge Copilot
tagline: Ask the handbook. Get answers with proof.

stack.web: Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind v4
stack.data: Supabase Postgres 17, pgvector, full-text search, Auth, RLS
stack.retrieval: hybrid pgvector + tsvector, reciprocal rank fusion, optional cross-encoder

models.llm: Groq primary, Gemini fallback, deterministic mock in tests

access_model.enforcement: SQL predicate inside search_chunks plus RLS policies

known_limits: The 512 MB free API instance cannot hold both ONNX models; reranking is disabled there.
Chat can return 502 while the instance restarts after a memory spike.
Demo role accounts share one password held outside the repository.
